scope: Plan review and isolated prerequisite checks; no implementation or spec edits.

checks.name: singleton-with-occupied-preferred-port
checks.method: Occupy an ephemeral loopback port with an unrelated HTTP server, then call startBroker twice with that preferred port and the same disposable state directory.
checks.limitation: Two broker instances in one test process; independent-process startup was not exercised. The initial sandbox attempt failed with listen EPERM; the approved isolated retry succeeded. All test listeners and temporary state were removed.

checks.name: relocated-state-read-policy
checks.method: Set C2C_STATE_DIR to a custom-state child of a disposable workspace and resolve custom-state/workspaces.json through the existing Workspace policy.
checks.limitation: Tests the existing read policy and the proposed name-based denylist premise; no write implementation exists yet.

checks.name: oauth-defaults
checks.method: Invoke the existing filterScopes with an omitted scope and an unsupported scope.
checks.limitation: workspace.write has not been added; the scope-expansion consequence is a plan-level inference.

checks.name: cwd-resolution
checks.method: Resolve an exact registered disposable root and its docs child with Git discovery unavailable.
checks.limitation: Documents current root-only behavior; the planned CLI does not exist yet.

planGaps: The process-local mutex depends on a single-instance guarantee that the current broker startup does not enforce for fallback ports.
Write-control protection must cover canonical resolved C2C state paths, including overrides and state-root workspace registrations.
OAuth must separate default read scopes from supported write scopes and update the currently unconditional read-only consent text.
Workspace mutation followed by terminal-receipt persistence has no defined handled persistence-failure outcome.
External edits during staging, replacement, or rollback are outside the mutex but are not explicitly excluded from stale-content guarantees.
Result-size caps do not bound source reads or rollback snapshot allocation before rejection.
Probe A supported / Probe B blocked contradicts acceptance criterion 57 and lacks one consistent capability matrix.

externalVerification.finding: Official developer documentation lists Plus/Pro write-tool support while the cited Help Center article still restricts full MCP support. Keep the real account probe and record host confirmation settings, including remembered approvals.

notRun: Production patch application or fault injection against a write implementation
